instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment. Put the flatbreads on it.
Bake the flatbreads for 3 minutes, until they just start to firm up.
Meanwhile, mince the garlic. In a bowl, stir together 1/2 cup of the BBQ sauce, the pizza sauce and the garlic.
Thinly slice the bell pepper and the quarter of red onion. In another bowl, toss the chicken with 1/4 cup of the BBQ sauce.
Take the flatbreads out. Spread the sauce mixture over each one, leaving a small border.
Scatter the chicken, bell pepper and onion over the sauce, then sprinkle the cheese on top.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are crisp and the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Drizzle with the remaining BBQ sauce, scatter the cilantro on top, and slice each flatbread.
method_notes: No version of this exact dish has 20 ratings with 4.0 or higher (Spend With Pennies has 5.0 from 2, Cup of Yum 5.0 from 3, Little Broken none) and RecipeTin Eats has no page for it, so this is a fallback lead: Spend With Pennies' flatbread (425°F, BBQ and pizza sauce mixed, bell pepper and red onion). Little Broken adds garlic in the sauce and chicken tossed in it, and Hidden Valley suggests baking the bread briefly first so it stays crisp. Uses store-bought rotisserie chicken so the whole dish stays under 30 minutes.
